caption: The drawing depicts a figurine of two human figures standing side by side on a rectangular base decorated with a pattern of triangles and dots colored in shades of yellow, orange, and black. The left figure appears to be male, dressed in a red shirt with a yellow collar, tan pants, and black boots, and is wearing a brown hat. His left hand is resting on his hip, and his right arm is draped around the shoulders of the other figure. The right figure appears to be female, dressed in a long, tan or brown dress with horizontal lines adorned with small, colorful red, green, and black spots, and a green shawl over her shoulders. Her hair is brown and parted in the center, and her right hand rests gently in front of her. Both figures have light skin tones and dark hair, and their facial features are simply rendered with lines and shading. The background of the drawing is blank, and the entire composition is framed by a thin, single-line border.
title: Fisherman and Woman
